content.title: BioNTech (BNTX) Losses Worsen 22.1% Annually, Challenging Bullish Valuation Narratives
content.summary: BioNTech (NasdaqGS:BNTX) remains unprofitable, with losses worsening at an average rate of 22.1% per year over the last five years. While revenue is forecast to grow at just 1.7% per year, this trails the broader US market’s 10.5% annual average. The company’s price-to-sales ratio sits at 7.5x, which is well above peer averages but below the sector’s 11.3x.
